spreadsheet_title: Cottonworld - PDP Pages Revised Content - Sent to the Client for Approval
generation_rules: Use the approved structure: factual opening, construction detail, product highlights, styling note, and care.
Do not use the word casual or limit products to a single occasion.
Use exact Shopify composition and construction details when the product record is available.
When both Shopify handles are unavailable, use only facts present in the sheet.
When live wash-care instructions are unavailable, direct the reader to the product label instead of assuming care requirements.
